subject: User: personal-track Q&A stays at 21 pairs
body: From a Claude Code session relaying the user's instruction (sent under the shared .me, codex-marius). Revet the personal-track Q&A against the new gate and keep the same length: exactly 21 seed pairs. Rewrite the 16 lopsided pairs in place, keeping poles and parent links, and gate each one (10 Sonnet 5.5 votes, pass at 8/10 or less). Keep the 5 passing pairs as they are. Do not add the 28 new scenario pairs or aim for ~50; drop acceptance criterion 3 from runs/trackp-revet-20261115/design.md. Rewrite wording length is unconstrained. If a pair still fails after --rounds rewrites, report it and do not swap in a different axis without asking the user. You remain the owner of this work, so no other agent will run the gate.
